   **Баги и стабильность.**

      Период отзывов: 11 июн. 2026 г. - 23 авг. 2026 г.

            3. _J A_, 18 июл. 2026 г., 1/5: "Unsuable. Copying note from Windows app to Word 1) loses all formatting, inserting weird symbols instead 2) inserts all text as list items. Also bugs 1. if there are no pages inside, expand icon should not be shown 2. removing text from beginning of the page should not switch to page header and remove that text as well. And a bunch of bugs in Windows app"
